blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Meralco PowerGen Corp. (MGEN) sees stronger growth prospects for its retail electricity arm as the government allows more small consumers to join the retail electricity market. With more than a decade in the market, MGEN Retail Electricity Supplier Inc. (MGEN RES) said its experience was “long enough to have watched the market it competes in and expand around it.” READ: Retail electricity market remains challenging–PCC Now, power regulators’ decision to reduce the threshold from 500 kilowatts to 100 kilowatts allows RES players to strengthen their presence further and accommodate factories, offices, hospitals, schools, hotels, retail locations and multi-site companies […]...
